text: Photography is a skill that combines creativity with technical knowledge. Using a tripod is essential for capturing sharp images, especially during low light conditions, as it eliminates the risk of camera shake and allows for sharper photos. Proper lighting is also crucial, as it can significantly enhance the overall look and feel of the photo. By positioning a light source to the side, you can create a flattering and balanced image. These two elements, tripod and lighting, go hand in hand to ensure your photographs turn out clear and captivating.
